title: Loki & MinIO
subtitle: Label-indexed log storage on cost-efficient S3-compatible object storage.

tiles.label: Log agents
tiles.says: Agents tail logs and attach labels.
tiles.detail: Alloy or Promtail add namespace and app labels, which shape cost and query speed.

tiles.label: Distributor
tiles.says: The distributor validates streams and hashes them to ingesters.
tiles.detail: Rate limits and replication protect the cluster and keep writes durable.

tiles.label: Ingester
tiles.says: Ingesters buffer in memory, protected by a WAL.
tiles.detail: Chunks flush when full or old, turning many small writes into efficient objects.

tiles.label: Chunks
tiles.says: Compressed chunks live in object storage.
tiles.detail: S3-compatible storage is inexpensive and durable, so retention is affordable.

tiles.label: Label index
tiles.says: The index maps label sets to chunks.
tiles.detail: Indexing labels only, not full text, keeps storage small and ingestion fast.

tiles.label: Compactor
tiles.says: The compactor merges indexes and applies retention.
tiles.detail: Retention policies delete old data automatically, which controls cost and compliance.

tiles.label: Query frontend
tiles.says: The frontend splits and caches large queries.
tiles.detail: Parallel sub-queries return long time ranges quickly.

tiles.label: Querier
tiles.says: Queriers read chunks and ingesters and filter lines.
tiles.detail: Label selectors narrow data first, then line filters scan only what remains.

tiles.label: LogQL
tiles.says: LogQL selects streams and derives metrics from logs.
tiles.detail: Rates and counts from logs enable alerting without extra instrumentation.

declarations: Loki indexes labels, not log lines.
Select by label first, filter second.
